chapter_notes: Chapter body ends on PDF 38 (reference list starts there); PDF 39-54 are references, not extracted (39-44 were rendered by accident in one call). Statements skipped under the 2026-11-23 update (target neither receptor nor enzyme): 1 statement covering 2 compounds (fluoxetine and escitalopram, serotonin and noradrenaline reuptake transporters, PDF 26). Also not recorded because the book names a target but no direction (agonist/antagonist/inhibitor etc.): L-DOPA at dopamine D2 (PDF 21), LSD and psilocybin at 5-HT2A (PDF 22), (-)DOB (PDF 22), quisqualate and (1S,3R)-ACPD binding (PDF 25), (R)-PCEP derivatives and LSP1-2111 at mGlu4 (PDF 29), NPL-2009 at mGlu5 in Table 1 (PDF 32, role cell blank). NMDA, AMPA and GABAC are recorded as receptors because the book calls them receptors; the chapter does not state whether they are ion-channel receptors, so a later filter may want to review those records (AP-7, MK-801, (R,S)-3-4-DCPG at AMPA, CGP35024 at GABAC).
